messages:
Keiko (SupplyOps): Heads-up: supplier reports 2x H100s failed POST on inbound to FRA gateway. They propose one consolidated RMA + single inspection to cut vendor fees. Need quick decision — EU provisioning cadence next week is tight.
Omar (Logistics): Post AWBs and weights pls. Consolidation saves handling but can add gateway dwell.
Keiko (SupplyOps): AWBs:
```
AWB: FR-SF-44221 (26.4kg)
AWB: FR-SF-44222 (27.1kg)
Proposed MAWB: FR-MAWB-9007
Carrier ETA if merged: 2026-07-07
```
Sana (Procurement): Vendor proposes declared value $275000 and requests we accept a $200 inspection surcharge to cover tech time. I'll push for vendor to waive surcharge or offer credit on next shipment.
Will (Infra): These units were earmarked for eu-west-2 burst pool. Thermal tolerance for returns ~60h in controlled hold; if gateway adds >24h we must either: 1) pull loaners from eu spare pool (DE) or 2) reschedule noncritical provisioning. Which direction preferred?
Keiko (SupplyOps): ops-bot opened RMA: RMA-4729. Labels pending. Link: https://redwood.internal/rma/RMA-4729
ops-bot: RMA-4729 created — attach photos + PO.
Omar (Logistics): Forwarder says consolidation adds 18 hrs at the FRA hub for QA manifesting. Brokerage quote consolidated = €260 vs separate €1,050. They can provide house manifest mapping AWBs -> MAWB.
Sana (Procurement): If we accept consolidation we need proforma/invoice mapping for VAT reclaim. Legal: avoid liability waivers unless vendor backs inspection. I'll request vendor-credit >= €400 and invoice lines.
Will (Infra): Contingency plan: I'll tag one node as 'degraded' and queue crossdock DE->FR if delay >30h. That takes ~8h prep but protects SLA. Also enabling biz hours oncall alert for thermal degradation.
Keiko (SupplyOps): Quick decision rule: proceed with consolidation if (a) broker fee <= €350 and (b) forwarder supplies house manifest and (c) vendor provides proforma within 12h. Else ship separate.
Sana (Procurement): Replied to vendor: "We will consolidate only if you credit inspection fee or accept liability; provide proforma+invoice lines and confirm declared value."
manifest-bot: Manifest uploaded to RMA-4729: https://files.redwood/rma/4729/manifest_v1.zip (maps AWBs -> MAWB)
Omar (Logistics): Manifest present and house mappings look clean. Final consolidated brokerage = €275. Forwarder confirms no additional customs delay beyond the 18h hub processing.
Sana (Procurement): Vendor offered €300 credit on brokerage and said they'd send proforma in morning. Pushing for full €450 but can accept €300 if operations greenlight.
Will (Infra): With 18h processing we remain under 48h thermal hold. I prefer consolidation — lower cost + minimal region impact. I'll proceed with spare hold as backup.
Keiko (SupplyOps): OK proceeding with consolidation per rule. Action items:
- Omar: finalize MAWB and labels; attach final manifest to RMA.
- Sana: log vendor credit under PO-2291-AMD3 and get proforma.
- Will: enable spare crossdock path (DE->FR) as contingency and monitor thermal alerts.
Omar (Logistics): Final MAWB confirmed and labels printed. Uploading final manifest now. :white_check_mark:
manifest-bot: Final manifest attached to RMA-4729: https://files.redwood/rma/4729/manifest_final.zip
ops-bot: RMA-4729 status -> Consolidation accepted. Track under INC-2026-511.
Keiko (SupplyOps): Thanks team. Ping here if customs or carrier asks for extra docs. :thumbsup:
